lines.say: By the sea stood a striped lighthouse, where a little mouse called Pip helped wise old Owl.
lines.show: By the sea stood a striped lighthouse, where a little mouse called Pip helped wise old Owl.

lines.say: One night, Owl gasped. "Three little stars have fallen from the sky!"
lines.show: One night, Owl gasped. "Three little stars have fallen from the sky!"

lines.say: Pip tiptoed into the sleepy forest. Under a fern, a star was twinkling.
lines.show: Pip tiptoed into the sleepy forest. Under a fern, a star was twinkling.

lines.say: Fox found the other two, and together they hung every star back on its silver string.
lines.show: Fox found the other two, and together they hung every star back on its silver string.

lines.say: The sky sparkled again. "Thank you, Pip," whispered Owl. Goodnight, little mouse.
lines.show: "Thank you, Pip," whispered Owl. Goodnight, little mouse.
